description:
Lossless codec for Neuropixels int16 (little-endian) data shaped (time, channels). It uses fast, fully reversible integer transforms tailored to spatiotemporal correlations, then strong entropy coding:
- Temporal first-order differencing per channel (along rows/time).
- Spatial first-order differencing across channels (along columns).
- ZigZag mapping of signed 16-bit residuals to unsigned 16-bit magnitudes.
- Byte shuffling (all low bytes first, then all high bytes) to expose long runs of 0x00/0xFF for better compression.
- LZMA compression (preset=6) with a tiny header.
Decoding reverses: LZMA decompress → unshuffle bytes → inverse ZigZag → prefix sums across channels → prefix sums across time. All arithmetic is exact under 16-bit two’s-complement wrap-around by using 32-bit accumulators and final casting. No external metadata beyond provided shape/dtype is used. Deterministic, fast, and memory-efficient, while typically achieving strong compression on neural voltage traces.
